input.summary: Insert Section 5.4: IBM convenience termination on 30 days' written notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, prevailing over the Section 5.1 for-cause preamble
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5.0 today allows exit only for cause, leaving us locked into a three-year term, so we have added Section 5.4 under which IBM may terminate this Agreement for its convenience on thirty (30) days' prior written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. The narrow "Notwithstanding Section 5.1" opener keeps the for-cause rights intact while ensuring that preamble is not read as an exclusive list; we can move to 60-90 days' notice as our fallback.

ops.text: 5.4 Termination for Convenience by IBM. Notwithstanding Section 5.1, IBM may terminate this Agreement for its convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to MSL, in which case MSL shall refund to IBM, pro rata, any fees prepaid by IBM for the period after the effective date of termination.
